name: Hachiko Inu
reason:
HACHIKO is the token of Hachiko Inu (https://hachiko.sbs), a community-driven memecoin on BNB Smart Chain inspired by the Japanese symbol of loyalty, Hachikō. Launched through Four.meme, it is a BEP-20 token with 18 decimals, an initial supply of 1,000,000,000 and 0% buy/sell tax.

Official token contract:
https://bscscan.com/token/0xF1c599E9A5FBDEA408a7409C0176a2fE42C64444

Liquidity: PancakeSwap V2 HACHIKO/WBNB. According to the official whitepaper, the LP tokens have been permanently burned, preventing the corresponding liquidity from being withdrawn.

Listed on CoinGecko:
https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hachiko-inu

Listed on CoinMarketCap:
https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hachiko-sbs/

Official documentation:
https://hachiko-inu.gitbook.io/hachiko-inu-whitepaper

We would like to confirm whether CoW Protocol’s BNB Chain solvers can currently quote and execute WBNB/HACHIKO trades using the existing PancakeSwap V2 liquidity, and whether any additional token-list submission or integration is required.
